notes: No model in the repo (examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/, model docstrings, default sources) reads from this class; only references are docs/modules listings, test/data/test_ecmwf.py and skills/. winning_model=null, variables = IFSLexicon.VOCAB (196 keys, earth2studio/lexicon/ecmwf.py:98-213; LEXICON = IFSLexicon) minus keys not present in the mirror for this request.

Availability checked against the S3 .index files for the chosen time, not by fetching every variable. The lexicon only fully matches recent cycles: at 2025-01-01..2026-02-01 the 10 hPa level, wave spectra (h1012..h2530, cdww, wmb) and others are absent; at 2026-06-01 cp/hcc/lcc/mcc are absent. Do not move `time` earlier without re-checking.
snowc (snowc::sfc::) is in VOCAB but absent from every index checked (2025-01-01 .. 2026-11-01), excluded.
time must be a 6-hourly cycle >= 2024-03-01 (ecmwf.py validate_time); source=aws keeps history, source=ecmwf only the last 4 days.
Analysis-style source: instantaneous variables come from step 0 of the requested cycle; the 6 *06 accumulation aliases come from step 6 of the previous cycle (2026-10-31T18Z), ecmwf.py:301-343.
member=1 (class default) -> type pf, number 1. member=0 (cf) warns that the control may no longer be offered (ecmwf.py:896).
